detailed_description:
Photoreal live-action, Ferrier's farm, Utah, 1860, moon from the left, black shadow, 35 mm film grain.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:04. The shot begins from <Picture 3>: a close shot of the sentinel's bearded face under the slouch hat's brim from below, his chin on his two bare hands folded over the rifle's muzzle, the moon's silver rim along the brim and the cheekbone from behind and the left, the rest of the face black, the stars behind. The camera is on the trail below the rock at the height of a mounted man's eye looking up, three long strides from him, a 50mm lens. The moon comes from behind and the LEFT. At the first frame the sentinel's face fills the CENTRE of the frame, half the frame height. The camera pulls back from the sentinel across the whole shot, travelling a hand's breadth as his hand lifts off the muzzle and waves once down the trail, a hand's breadth, from 00:00 to 00:03. <Subject 1> (S1), on screen, a lean weathered man of about thirty-five, with a clipped English voice at an even pace, says: <d>[English] Pass on, then, and the Lord go with you.</d> His mouth shapes every syllable as the line is heard and closes on the last word. At 00:03, as the line ends, his head nods once, then the coat skirt stirs, and the movement continues to the last frame of the shot. By 00:04 the camera is pulling back through the last frame, and the action continues with it.
[Shot 2] From 00:04 to 00:06. At 00:04 the shot cuts to a wide from the sentinel's rock looking down into the canyon, beginning from <Picture 4>: the three riders going away from the camera at a trot down the pale dust between the black boulders, small and black, the rifle's muzzle and the sentinel's coat sleeve in the near left corner, the moon rimming the far crag. The camera is on the sentinel's rock HIGH ABOVE the trail, looking steeply DOWN so the riders' hat crowns and the horses' backs are seen from above, a 35mm lens. The moon comes from behind and the LEFT. At the first frame the three riders are small at the CENTRE of the lower third going away down the pale trail. The camera tilts down across the whole shot, travelling a hand's breadth as the three riders go away down the trail at a trot growing smaller, from 00:04 to 00:05. At 00:05 the coat sleeve in the near corner lifts a hand's breadth, then dust drifts off the trail to the right, and the movement continues to the last frame of the shot. By 00:06 the camera is tilting down through the last frame, and the action continues with it.
